name: GoUltra for WooCommerce
author: GoUltra.AI

sections.description:
GoUltra for WooCommerce brings WhatsApp into your WooCommerce store, managed entirely from WordPress. Compose and send opt-in WhatsApp marketing campaigns to the shoppers who chose to hear from you, and automatically send order confirmations, shipping and tracking updates, and consent-based abandoned-cart reminders, all through the WhatsApp Cloud API from Meta. A free WhatsApp chat button also lets visitors message your store in one tap, with no GoUltra account required.

Build approved message templates in 20+ languages, preview each one exactly as it will look on WhatsApp, and run opt-in marketing campaigns, all without leaving your WordPress dashboard. Order and shipping updates are transactional and go out automatically for the WooCommerce statuses you choose. Marketing and abandoned-cart messages are sent only to customers who explicitly opt in at checkout, and you can search, export or unsubscribe your audience at any time.

Send WhatsApp marketing campaigns

Create a campaign from your opted-in shoppers, map your template variables, add a header image, and preview it before it sends. Send now or schedule for later, and follow every campaign in the history with pause and cancel.

Core workflows

  • WhatsApp marketing campaigns – Compose and send consent-based campaigns from WordPress through your connected GoUltra account, with a live preview, a test send, and send-now or schedule options.
  • Marketing audience – Automatically add consenting shoppers to a searchable audience that you can export and unsubscribe from marketing.
  • Abandoned-cart recovery – Run a configurable three-step reminder sequence only for shoppers who explicitly opted in to WhatsApp marketing.
  • Free WhatsApp chat button – Add a one-tap chat button (floating widget, shortcode or product-page button) so visitors can message your store. Works with no GoUltra account, using a standard WhatsApp click-to-chat link.
  • Order confirmations and status updates – Send the customer an approved WhatsApp template when an order is created or moves to a WooCommerce status you choose.
  • Shipping notifications – Send shipping and tracking updates, including compatibility with Advanced Shipment Tracking (AST).
  • Multilingual templates – Create and manage WhatsApp templates in 20+ languages, including ready-to-use starter content in major languages.
  • Admin alerts – Send new-order alerts to an authorized store administrator.
  • Operational visibility – Review message activity, API responses and recent webhook events.

Built for WooCommerce operations

  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and classic + block-based checkout.
  • Processes outbound events asynchronously, so checkout never waits for the messaging API.
  • Integrates with WordPress personal-data export and erase tools.

Languages

The plugin interface follows the WordPress site language and is available in English, Hebrew, Arabic, Spanish and French. Hebrew and Arabic include right-to-left layouts. The template builder includes starter content in 20+ languages.

External services

This plugin relies on GoUltra, a third-party service, to deliver messages. Nothing is transmitted until an administrator enters a GoUltra API key on the settings screen. All requests go to https://go.goultra.ai/api.

What is sent, and when:

  • Connecting the store (when you click Connect): your API key, site URL, and the plugin, WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
  • Order and shipping notifications (only for the WooCommerce statuses you enable): customer first and last name, phone number, email address, order number, order total, currency, item summary, product image URL, order URL and payment method.
  • Abandoned-cart reminders (only for shoppers who tick the marketing opt-in at checkout): customer name, phone number, email address, cart total, cart contents, checkout URL and, on the third reminder, a generated coupon code.
  • Marketing audience and campaigns (only for shoppers who tick the marketing opt-in): phone number, name and email address, plus the message content you compose.
  • Store policies (only if you click Sync Policies): the policy text you enter.
  • Product catalogue: GoUltra can read your in-stock products from /wp-json/goultra/v1/sync. That route requires the per-site shared secret.

The plugin also answers a public read-only route, /wp-json/goultra/v1/info, which returns only your site title, site URL, shop currency and locale so the connection screen can be pre-filled. It returns no customer, order, credential or version information.

The free WhatsApp chat button sends nothing anywhere: it is a plain click-to-chat link and the visitor’s own app opens the conversation.

Service terms: GoUltra Terms of Service and GoUltra Privacy Policy. GoUltra subscription charges and Meta messaging charges are separate.

GoUltra is an independent software service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Meta or WhatsApp. WhatsApp and Meta are trademarks of their respective owners.

Your store remains responsible for its consent text, privacy notices, audience eligibility and applicable legal requirements.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the goultra-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu (WooCommerce must be installed and active).
  3. Go to GoUltra -> Settings in the admin sidebar.
  4. Create a GoUltra account at goultra.ai/register if you do not have one.
  5. Paste your API key and click Connect.
  6. Choose which notifications to enable and which approved templates to use.
sections.faq:
Do I need a GoUltra account?

Yes, to send WhatsApp messages. Order, shipping, abandoned-cart and marketing messages all send through an active GoUltra account. You can create one at goultra.ai/register. The free WhatsApp chat button works without a GoUltra account.

Can I send WhatsApp marketing campaigns from WordPress?

Yes. You can compose and send opt-in WhatsApp marketing campaigns to your consenting audience directly from the GoUltra menu in WordPress, with a live preview and a test send. Campaigns go only to shoppers who explicitly opted in to WhatsApp marketing.

Can I schedule a WhatsApp campaign?

Yes. Choose send-now or pick a date and time to schedule a campaign, then follow it in the campaign history with pause and cancel.

Can I preview a campaign before it sends?

Yes. The composer shows a live WhatsApp-style preview of your template with your variables and header image filled in, and you can send a test message to your own verified number first.

Do I need a GoUltra account to use the WhatsApp chat button?

No. The WhatsApp chat button is a standard WhatsApp click-to-chat link (wa.me) to your own number. It works with no GoUltra account and sends no data to any service; the customer’s own WhatsApp opens the conversation.

Can I build my own WhatsApp message templates?

Yes. The template builder lets you create order, shipping, admin, abandoned-cart and marketing templates in 20+ languages and submit them for Meta approval, with a required opt-out on marketing templates.

How much does it cost?

The WordPress plugin is free to install. An active GoUltra account is required to send messages. GoUltra subscription charges and Meta WhatsApp messaging charges are separate.

Can I send marketing messages to every WooCommerce customer?

No. Marketing and abandoned-cart messages are limited to contacts who have explicitly opted in to WhatsApp marketing at checkout. Order and shipping (utility) updates are transactional and are not marketing. Store owners remain responsible for their consent wording and legal obligations.

Does the plugin slow down checkout?

No. Outbound message events are queued asynchronously, so checkout does not wait for the GoUltra API to respond.

How does it handle consent and personal data?

Marketing messages (such as abandoned-cart recovery) require an explicit, unchecked-by-default opt-in at checkout and are sent only to customers who consent. Consent is re-checked before each marketing send, and unsubscribe stops marketing without affecting transactional order and shipping updates. The plugin also integrates with WordPress personal-data export and erase tools.

Does this work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with HPOS and with both classic and block-based checkout.
sections.changelog:
The three most recent releases are below. Older entries are in changelog.txt.

3.9.26

  • Plugin name updated to “GoUltra for WooCommerce” to follow the WordPress.org directory naming guidelines on trademarks. Banner artwork updated for the same reason. No functionality changed.
  • Reviewed the REST API routes: the only public route is read-only and returns information already public on the storefront. All others require the per-site shared secret.

3.9.25

  • Chat button: choose any button color, with a one-click reset to the default green.
  • Settings sections can be collapsed and expanded, and remember their state.
  • Template pickers: all labels now follow the plugin language, and a new view button shows exactly which template is selected.
  • Admin alerts: the verified store-manager number and the admin alert number are now one field. Verifying fills it in automatically and shows a Verified badge.
  • Quiet Hours is now off by default and clearly explained: it only delays abandoned-cart marketing reminders. Order and shipping confirmations always send immediately, at any hour.

3.9.24

  • New: a free WhatsApp chat button (floating widget, [goultra_whatsapp_button] shortcode, and an optional product-page button) so visitors can message your store in one tap. It uses a standard WhatsApp click-to-chat link and needs no GoUltra account.
  • The listing and in-plugin wording now lead with WhatsApp marketing campaigns.
  • Refreshed screenshots.
